purpose: Editorial cover illustrations, not application screenshots

prompts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a premium editorial 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for ARCHON, an actual AWS Strands application helping independent joiners reconcile supplied invoice and remittance evidence before approving an exact collection email. This is an illustrative cover, NOT a screenshot or fabricated application UI. Dark midnight navy and muted plum background with luminous mint accents, clean white geometric typography, sophisticated restrained 3D paper geometry and thin evidence-connection lines, generous negative space, exceptional mobile readability. Large exact text "ARCHON". Secondary exact text on two lines "CHECK THE BALANCE." and "APPROVE THE EMAIL." Small supporting exact text "Strands Agents · Amazon Bedrock". One legible central visual metaphor: two paper cards reading "INVOICE €1,860" and "PAYMENT €600", leading to a simple outlined envelope with the text "€1,260 REMAINING"; beside envelope a human-approval check icon. These figures are a fictional product example and not evidence of actual money recovered. No phone, no fake interface screenshot, no bank icon or bank matched label, no Aurora, no database logos, no invoice approval, no automated-send implication, no currencies other than EUR, no awards or superiority assertions. Keep all title text inset 7%, leave bottom-right corner quiet for YouTube duration badge. Polished professional cover, not a busy infographic.
